glosses: A hybrid martial art derived from Muay Thai, karate, and especially boxing during the 1960s to 1970s; more generally, any stand-up combat sport that combines kicks and punches.

examples.text: Ex world’s champion [Georges] Carpentier was also expert at kick-boxing.
The Japanese kickboxing gym, recently opened in the Thai capital, had been a great success
